items.title: Astra can read and write weights to improve Qwen

extra.evidence: We find that frontier LLMs are surprisingly good at natively reading and writing neural network weights, well past what we’d expect from humans or conventional algorithms. Just by looking at the raw weights, GPT-6 Astra can tell what a network was trained to do . And without any environment feedback, it has no trouble writing, from scratch, small game-playing networks that outplay networks trained with PPO for 100 million steps. Likewise, asked to make Qwen3.5-0.8B better at math without gradients, Astra identifies an issue in its weights causing reasoning loops that Qwen’s own model card warns about, and fixes this by natively editing 0.016% of the weights . Revenue for Q3 was reportedly $16.8 billion. At first glance, this number seems astonishing. And, in one sense, it is. It’s another jaw-dropping sequential gain for what is likely the fastest-growing company in history. But, break the trend down into implied monthly growth, and the picture looks different. items.title: AI+科研：Agent加速科研，论文写得快了，成果更难评了 ｜ 西湖大学工学院博导 王欢分享

extra.evidence: 王欢从高效AI与AI评测双视角，剖析AI智能体对科研流程加速与评价体系冲击的双重影响。他指出Agent正显著提升文献筛选、代码编写等科研效率，但论文产出速度提升未同步带来科学认知进步，反而加剧成果可信度鉴别与评审压力。 在 1024 模力工场 · AI社区日 主论坛上，西湖大学工学院助理教授、博士生导师、高效智能计算实验室（ENCODE Lab）负责人王欢，以 《AI 智能体对科研的影响》 为题作主题分享。 王欢有两个重点研究方向：Efficient AI（高效人工智能），关注如何提高 AI 的运行效率、降低资源消耗；AI Evaluation（AI 评测），关注如何定义和衡量智能。 这次分享中，他结合计算机和 AI 研究的经历，讨论了 Agent 带来的两方面影响。一方面正好也关于“效率”：读文献、写代码、做实验等工作正在加速；另一方面则关于“评价”：论文更容易产出，也给成果鉴别、同行评审和科研评价带来了更大压力。 他认为，Agent 确实加快了科研进程：Agent 能自主决定下一步、调用工具执行任务，Harness 则提供上下文管理、工具调用等支持，让大模型能够持续开展工作；他自己每天早上 6 点，还会收到 Agent 筛选推荐的 10 篇相关文献。 但论文产出更快，不等于科学进步更快：科研旨在增进认识，结论需要接受检验，大量成果都声称有新发现时，如何判断它们是否可靠、究竟新在哪里，就成了更紧迫的问题。 与此同时，科研评价仍看重论文等量化成果，因此当一些老师倡议“慢科研”、呼吁重质量而非数量时，也有学生反问：老师自己发了那么多论文，为什么要求我们慢下来？ 在王欢看来，Agent 的影响已超出效率提升，触及科研评价制度：论文越来越容易产出，评价体系该如何识别真正的贡献？ 不过，他仍持乐观态度：AI 接手部分工作，也让人有更多空间思考，哪些探索和判断仍需要自己承担，以及人…

items.title: Apriel Voice 27B Preview: An Open Model for Speech, Reasoning, and Tool Use
items.summary: A capable voice assistant must do more than recognize words; it must understand requests, reason over context, sustain conversations, and act through tools. We present Apriel Voice 27B Preview, an open speech-language model that unifies these capabilities within a shared reasoning backbone while retaining text and image input modalities. Built on the post-trained Gemma 4 26B-A4B checkpoint, Apriel Voice directly processes speech and generates both responses and tool calls without requiring a separate dialogue model. We introduce a two-stage training procedure to adapt the model to speech. The first stage establishes the speech interface, while the second jointly adapts the projector and backbone through supervised fine-tuning, text replay, and source-dependent cross-entropy and forward Kullback--Leibler divergence supervision. Automatically constructed speech-conditioned dialogues provide conversational training data, while local teacher serving, overlapping teacher and student computation, and fused full-vocabulary losses enable efficient online distillation. In thinking mode, Apriel Voice achieves a score of 98.90 on Big Bench Audio, 81.13 on Speech-BFCL, and a task success rate of 65.51% on $τ$-Voice, with a mean latency of 1.91 seconds. It also achieves 51.27% English EVA accuracy and 74.13% experience pass@1. Finally, we deploy Apriel Voice 27B Preview on a custom serving platform to support interactive voice interactions.

items.title: FrameForge: Harnessing Priors of Video Foundation Models for Unified Image Generation
items.summary: Unified conditional image generation requires a single model to preserve different aspects of a visual input while producing a target image that follows textual guidance. Pretrained video models provide a promising foundation by encoding visual transformations across time, yet existing approaches typically assign the condition and target to fixed temporal positions. We observe that condition-target relationships vary substantially across generation tasks, while video models naturally encode visual transformations at different temporal scales. This motivates us to model conditional generation through input-adaptive virtual temporal relations. We propose FrameForge, which captures two complementary aspects of such relations. Mixture of Temporal Experts (MoTE) models how far the target lies from the condition by dynamically selecting temporal RoPE experts with different virtual intervals. Chain of Temporal Reasoning (CoTR) models how the condition is transformed into the target through a latent intermediate state, with a reasoning-bottleneck attention mask encouraging information propagation through this pathway. Experiments on DreamBench, COCO2017, and GEdit-Bench show that FrameForge achieves superior performance in subject-driven generation, canny-to-image generation, and image editing among the compared methods.

items.title: R^2Orch: Recursive Self-Improvement for Agent Orchestration via Self-Play within a Skill-Internalization Loop
items.summary: In recent years, agentic orchestration has been widely applied to solve complex human tasks. However, existing orchestration learning still faces key challenges, including hand-designed curricula, advantage collapse when a task's rollouts all reach the same outcome, and unreliable evaluation signals that judge each skill by one noisy score. To address these challenges, we propose R^2Orch, a new paradigm of Recursive Self-Play Orchestration: an inner loop of self-play that improves the orchestrator on self-chosen tasks, and an outer loop that improves how the inner loop improves. To support this paradigm, we introduce Recursive Learnability, a training objective that rewards a Proposer for choosing tasks whose rollouts keep reaching different outcomes as skills are withdrawn. Built on this objective, we further propose Skill Withdrawal, in which the outer loop withdraws each skill once a controlled evaluation within self-play shows that the orchestrator performs as well without it. Moreover, the two loops form one cycle: failures are distilled into skills, skills into parameters, and withdrawals lead the Proposer to new failures, so the orchestrator moves toward zero-skill deployment. Experimental results on twelve datasets show that R^2Orch consistently outperforms baselines across question answering, math, code, and interactive tasks. Our code is available at https://github.com/beita6969/R2Orch.

items.title: WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments
items.summary: Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites. Capture-and-replay preserves observations, with interaction coverage constrained by captured content and replay capabilities. We present WebAnything, a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable Web environments from real URLs without per-site manual implementation or repair after initial setup and authorization. An Explorer-Builder collects browser-observable structures, resources, and interaction outcomes; an independent verifier checks frozen candidates and guides local repair or targeted source recapture. We construct 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains and 53 categories, supporting 12,984 executed and accepted tasks. Compared with human-assisted WebHarbor, WebAnything achieves higher aggregate scores on three fidelity metrics, with 12 wins, two ties, and no losses in a blind audit. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on 5,856 interaction trajectories improves REAL success by 9.9 percentage points, Odysseys-Easy Rubric Avg and Task Avg by 6.25 and 6.32 percentage points, and WebArena-Verified Overall success by 13.33 percentage points under the fixed harness. Code: https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Web-Anything

items.title: DAMI: Dual-Axis Memory Initialization for Enhanced Long-Context Retrieval in Gated Linear Attention
items.summary: Linear attention scales linearly with sequence length, but its finite-state memory can limit long-context retrieval. In gated linear recurrences, memory retention depends on state decay, which is shaped jointly by gate parameters A_log and dt_bias and by input activations. In controlled Gated DeltaNet (GDN) experiments, both parameters remain highly correlated with their initial values after training, highlighting the importance of initialization. Therefore, we introduce Dual-Axis Memory Initialization (DAMI), which jointly configures these parameters before training. DAMI assigns geometric timescales across heads for varied retrieval distances and a low-high-low input-sensitivity profile across layers. A small activation sample calibrates the GDN-family implementation to match both behavioral targets without adding trainable parameters. Across GDN, KDA, GDN2, Mamba-2, and RWKV-7, DAMI improves average RULER-style retrieval accuracy by 5.29 to 16.71 percentage points over the corresponding random-initialization baselines. Performance on language modeling, commonsense reasoning, and 2K real-world retrieval remains broadly comparable to those baselines. Our code is available at https://speedai.com/research/dami.

entries.body: 论文针对智能体编排学习中课程设计、优势崩溃和评估信号不可靠等挑战，提出了 R^2Orch 递归自我博弈编排范式。该方法通过内部自我博弈循环和外部技能撤回循环，利用递归可学习性目标来改进编排者对自我选择任务的优化。实验在问答、数学、代码和交互任务上验证了 R^2Orch 的一致优越性。

entries.headline: WebAnything：从野生网络到可扩展智能体环境
entries.body: 论文介绍了一种名为 WebAnything 的全自动化框架，旨在从真实 URL 构建可重用的源 grounded Web 环境，以解决智能体训练和评估中环境构建困难的问题。该方法通过探索者-构建器和独立验证器模块，自动收集结构、资源和交互结果，并支持 244 个网站工件和 12,984 个执行任务。在真实成功率和 WebArena-Verified 等指标上，WebAnything 相比人工辅助…

entries.headline: DAMI：门控线性注意力中增强长上下文检索的双轴记忆初始化
entries.body: 论文针对门控线性注意力中有限状态记忆限制长上下文检索的问题，提出了双轴记忆初始化（DAMI）方法。该方法在训练前联合配置门控参数 A_log 和 dt_bias，通过几何时间尺度和低-高-低输入敏感性配置来优化记忆保留。实验表明，DAMI 在 GDN、KDA、Mamba-2 等模型上，将平均 RULER 风格检索准确率提高了 5.29 到 16.71 个百分点。
